posts.body:
Faith Forward Is Here

Today we launch a mission born on the streets of St. Louis.

Faith Forward Foundation serves displaced and homeless veterans, their families, and the dogs who walk beside them, with supplies, resources, and faith-based care. Founded on All Saints' Day by a three-tour Iraq veteran and ordained deacon.

Faith Forward is building a faith-based model of veteran outreach in St. Louis, and we are looking for partners who share it.

👉 Follow along and share with one veteran you know.

posts.title: Why Dogs?
posts.body:
Why Dogs?

Most unhoused veterans have a dog. Here's why that matters.

A dog is warmth on a freezing night, security at 3 a.m., and a reason to get up. Too many shelters force veterans to choose between a bed and their dog. We refuse to make anyone choose.

Pet barriers are one of the most overlooked causes of chronic veteran homelessness. Our K9 program tackles that gap directly.

👉 Share if you believe no veteran should have to choose.

posts.body:
Six Months of Faith Forward

Look what God has done in six months.

Blessed backpacks, warm socks, fed dogs, answered prayers, new partners, and veterans walked home. Thank you for being part of it.

Faith Forward is building a faith-based model of veteran outreach in St. Louis, and we are looking for partners who share it.

👉 Share your favorite Faith Forward moment.

posts.title: Saturday Prayer: Commissioning
posts.body:
Saturday Prayer: Commissioning

Lord, send us.

You call us from the streets to send us back into them. Commission us as ambassadors of Your mercy. Here am I, Lord. Send me. Amen.

Faith-based organizations bring something unique to veteran care: presence, meaning, and community that lasts after the appointment ends.

👉 Pray this and then go serve.
